title.zh: 局部状态不变的关系转化与充分约化
title.en: Relational transformation with unchanged local states and a sufficient reduction

claim.zh: 对每条带动作的变化之律与每个约化：约化值上有一条确定的律承载每一步，当且仅当约化合并的构型被每个动作带到它合并的构型；与每个动作交换的约化律与每段动作序列交换。在明示两量子位实振幅片段中，实际相位操作保留双方完整局部密度与联合基底分布，而同一后续受控 X 操作产生不同控制响应；所以局部密度对不承载规律，不能统一给出下一控制状态。保留相应共同交叉项的四整数摘要承载规律，对指定交互与相位操作的任意有限序列给出精确控制密度和响应：两者都是实例。
claim.en: For every law of change with moves and every reduction: some determined law on the reduced values carries every step exactly when configurations the reduction merges are taken by each move to configurations it merges; a reduced law that commutes with every move commutes with every course of moves. In the specified two-qubit real-amplitude fragment, an actual phase operation preserves both complete local densities and the joint basis distribution, while the same subsequent controlled-X gives different control responses; so the local density pair carries no law and cannot uniformly determine the next control state. A four-integer summary retaining the relevant joint cross contribution carries one, giving exact control densities and responses for every finite word of the supplied interaction and phase operations: both are instances.

hypotheses.zh: 整数实振幅与密度分子；主要物理见证的振幅除以根号2，密度除以2，最终省略见证的范数为1。任意整数输入的一般结论是代数恒等式。
hypotheses.en: Integer real amplitudes and density numerators; main physical witnesses divide amplitudes by sqrt 2 and densities by 2, while the final omission witnesses have norm 1. General integer-input conclusions are algebraic identities.

hypotheses.zh: H制备、受控X、第一坐标Z、偏迹与测量含义来自明示量子框架；共同操作的实际访问条件保留。
hypotheses.en: H preparation, controlled-X, first-coordinate Z, partial trace and measurement interpretation are supplied by the declared quantum framework; actual joint-operation access remains required.

hypotheses.zh: 任意有限词精确性限于两类指定操作及第一坐标响应；复用既有SystemsOrganization的同一状态接续定理。
hypotheses.en: All-finite-word exactness is restricted to the two specified operations and first-coordinate responses; it reuses the existing SystemsOrganization theorem preserving reached-state composition.

correspondence.zh: 同一制备中分化的两个坐标表示操作角色。相位实际改变共同振幅关系，再以相同交互和测量比较后续；summary_update_exact的输出满足旧evolve_semiconjugacy的输入，summary_recovers_control连接测量。标准量子效应及一般约化定理不作为新发现。
correspondence.en: Two coordinates differentiate operation roles within one preparation. Phase changes the joint amplitude relation before a common interaction and measurement compare continuations. summary_update_exact supplies the old evolve_semiconjugacy premise, and summary_recovers_control connects its output to measurement. Neither the standard quantum effect nor the general reduction theorem is claimed as a new discovery.

detail.zh: 形式源码复用该模块的操作与约化定义；此前丧失／恢复定理本身不是新障碍的推理前提。
detail.en: The formal source reuses that module’s operation and reduction definitions; the prior loss/recovery theorem is not itself a premise of the new obstruction.

detail.zh: 同一变化研究中的独立范围：既有准备步骤界与本次共同关系在局部状态不变时的变化；无形式证明依赖。
detail.en: Distinct scopes in the same change study: preparation bounds and joint transformation with unchanged local states; no formal proof dependency.

detail.zh: 在Becoming整体内接通具体关系转化；不把局部构造当成整个理论的演绎必要性。
detail.en: Connects a concrete relational transformation within Becoming as a whole; it does not establish the whole theory’s deductive necessity.

detail.zh: no_local_pair_update保留双方完整局部状态却反驳统一下一步更新；summary_omits_other_relations显示正面摘要仍省略寄存器关系，扩充操作范围需重新验证。
detail.en: no_local_pair_update preserves both full local states but refutes a uniform next-step update; summary_omits_other_relations shows the sufficient summary still omits register relations, so enlarged operation scope requires renewed validation.

detail.zh: 完整量子状态与指定操作同样解释全部结果；此次反例针对局部约化，未反驳强的已有量子解释。
detail.en: The full quantum state and specified operators explain all results equally; the obstruction targets the local reduction and does not refute the adequate conventional quantum account.

limitations.zh: 未证明任意复数或混合态的全量子行为、所有操作下的最小摘要、物理实验、因果不可分离、普遍本体或伦理权威。Becoming整体的强零实质公理目标保持。
limitations.en: Does not prove full behavior for arbitrary complex or mixed states, a minimal summary for every operation, hardware realization, causal nonseparability, universal ontology or ethical authority. The strong zero-substantive-axiom goal for Becoming as a whole remains open.

validation_scope.zh: Lean4.29.1新模块11项定理声明／25项审计通过，21空、4仅propext；继承74项定理／123项审计分列，总148项审计134空14标准。源码、导入闭包、签名与回执绑定；作者反审，无独立代理验收。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1 checks 11 module theorem declarations / 25 audits, 21 empty and four using only propext. Separately credits 74 inherited theorems / 123 audits: total 148, 134 empty and 14 standard. Source, import closure, signatures and receipt bound; author counterreview, no independent-agent acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 将已取得的关系保留条件用于Becoming整体的构成性论证；不重开此已完成操作接口，不要求每次变化都具生成性，也不把另一局部模型当作普遍演绎。
next_delta.en: Use the established relation-retention condition in the constitutive account of Becoming as a whole. Do not reopen this completed operational interface, require every change to be generative, or treat another local model as the universal deduction.

history.en: 2026-10-09: §12 of the existing change study extends the checked joint-operation module with actual transformation preserving both full local states and a sufficient reduction for arbitrary finite words. Retains the first successful snapshot and the final check after clarifying a normalization comment. Credits conventional physics and the inherited reduction theorem separately.
